_about: P02 capture validation. 'packets': layouts corrected or first annotated from captures (they override earlier annotation files that sort before P02.json). 'evidence': opcodes whose existing annotation a capture confirmed field by field, without changing it (tools ignore this key; capture-validation.md is the readable form). Capture names are re-data/captures/26_11_15_<name>.pcapng.
